<thought>We have the product composed of two fragments: the unchanged fragment "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1" and the fluorinated fragment "FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1". Applying retrosynthetic template 1914395 to the fluorinated fragment yields the alcohol precursor "OC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1". Combining this with the unchanged fragment gives the full set of precursors.</thought>
<final_answer>[["COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1", "OC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1"]]</final_answer>
